content:
The issue is reproduced: with `atomicSelectors: true`, `selectorHealth` is undefined and changing `user.age` re-evaluates a selector that reads only `user.name`.

The available repository has no `main` ref or configured remote, so I created `atomic-signal-selectors` from the available `master` ref instead. The existing selector test suite passed (7 tests).

The implementation, build verification, and requested commit remain incomplete; no source files have been changed.
